name: Hasuda (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hasuda city emblem in red: a sun-like device of pointed rays enclosing a ring with a cross.
history: Municipal flag of Hasuda, a city in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 30 September 1972.

features.role: Hasuda city emblem — a sun-like device of pointed rays enclosing a ring with a cross
